**Fifth Third Bancorp (FITB) 3Q26: Strong Post-Comerica Inflection with 20.6% Adjusted ROTCE**

**Headline & EPS Drivers:** Discussing **adjusted** diluted EPS, FITB delivered $1.13 in 3Q26, up sharply from 2Q26 (reported GAAP EPS was $0.90 vs. $0.83 in 2Q26, +8% QoQ) [B0008, B0030]. Reported results included $(0.23) per share ($211 million after-tax) of notable items: $171 million after-tax ($225 million pre-tax) in Comerica merger-related charges, $26 million after-tax in interchange litigation matters, and $14 million after-tax in technology asset impairments [B0071-B0075, B1325]. Stripping these out, earnings power accelerated on 8% QoQ adjusted PPNR growth to $1,512 million (+450 bps positive operating leverage) [B0016, B1177], a $7 million lower credit provision ($122 million) [B0058], and a 90 bps lower effective tax rate (21.8%) [B0295].

**Revenue & Margin:** GAAP NII rose $56 million (+3% QoQ) to $2,271 million ($2,276 million FTE) on higher market rates, fixed-rate asset repricing, loan growth, and one extra day [B0024, B0025, B0092, B1257]. FTE NIM slipped 2 bps QoQ to 3.34%, entirely due to elevated conversion-related cash (-4 bps) and day count (-1 bp), while core loan/deposit performance (+2 bps) and fixed-rate repricing (+1 bp) expanded underlying margin [B0044, B1257]. Reported noninterest income fell 5% QoQ to $1,008 million on $39 million of litigation/merger charges and $(5) million securities losses [B0108, B0116-B0119]; adjusted noninterest income rose 1% QoQ to $1,052 million as mortgage (+21%), commercial banking (+2%), wealth (+1%), and commercial payments (+1%) outweighed a 5% dip in capital markets [B0100-B0105, B0121]. Reported expenses fell 3% QoQ to $2,049 million [B0137]; adjusted expenses ex-deferred comp fell 2% QoQ to $1,816 million, driving the adjusted efficiency ratio down 250 bps to 54.6% (reported 62.4%) [B0152, B1172, B1173].

**Credit:** Asset quality remained resilient. NCOs were $139 million, or 0.31% of average portfolio loans (+1 bp QoQ) [B0275]. The ACL ratio eased 2 bps to 1.74% ($3,131 million), covering NPLs by 292% [B0259, B0261, B0262]. NPAs ticked up 4 bps to 0.64% due to $74 million of Comerica branch real estate moved to OREO [B0245, B0277].

**Capital & Returns:** Reported ROTCE rose 100 bps to 16.6%, while adjusted ROTCE hit 20.6% (+160 bps QoQ) [B0042, B1168]. CET1 climbed 9 bps to 10.02% with zero share buybacks [B0288, B0292]; TBVPS fell 5% QoQ to $22.01 on a $1.6 billion AOCI widening [B0032, B0036].

**Guidance & Thesis:** With the Comerica systems conversion complete and the full $850 million expense synergy run-rate locked in for 4Q26 [B1253], 4Q26 guidance projects NII up 2.5%–3.5%, fees up 2%–4%, adjusted expenses down 2%–3%, and NCOs at 30–35 bps [B1273]. Execution de-risks the Comerica merger and strengthens the bull thesis.
